artifacts.name: Employee Records Dashboard
artifacts.description: Interactive Power BI report with writeback capability for employee records
artifacts.deployment_notes: Deploy after semantic model. Configure UDF endpoint in button actions.

artifacts.name: Semantic Model
artifacts.description: Data model connecting to HRData SQL endpoint
artifacts.deployment_notes: Create from HRData SQL endpoint. Configure relationships and measures. See scripts/03-semantic-model-setup.md

artifacts.name: HRData
artifacts.description: Central SQL database storing employee records and writeback staging tables
artifacts.deployment_notes: Deploy first. Run scripts/01-table-creation.sql to create schema. Includes Employees and NeedsWriteback tables.

artifacts.name: HRData
artifacts.description: SQL endpoint for querying HRData database
artifacts.deployment_notes: Automatically created with SQL Database. Use for semantic model connection.

artifacts.name: Pipeline_IngestEmployees
artifacts.description: Initial data ingestion pipeline to load employee data into HRData

artifacts.name: Pipeline_Writeback_to_On-Prem
artifacts.description: Syncs writeback changes from NeedsWriteback table to on-premises SQL Server
artifacts.deployment_notes: Requires on-premises gateway. Configure connection and stored procedure. See scripts/04-pipeline-syncback-config.md and artifacts/pipelines/pipeline-definition.json

artifacts.name: EmployeeWritebackFunctions
artifacts.description: UDF that receives writeback requests from Power BI and inserts into NeedsWriteback staging table
artifacts.deployment_notes: Deploy UDF with code from artifacts/udf/udf-with-pipeline-trigger.py. Configure endpoint URL. Test with sample POST request. UDF also triggers Pipeline_Writeback_to_On-Prem.

external_dependencies: Azure Key Vault (optional, for secure credential storage)
